icml-submission.name: icml-submission
icml-submission.purpose: ICML 2026 submission crunch — benchmark eval paper. Coordination through the deadline.

icml-submission.text: Status check on the eval runs — we submit tomorrow. No extensions possible. If we miss ICML there's no backup plan, this is our one shot. Need the results table finalized tonight.
Reminder that the intro and the whole narrative assume all 5 benchmarks. Dropping 2 means a full paper rewrite, which we cannot do in 24 hours. The results table just needs numbers in every cell.

Also — the competing lab just posted a preprint with similar results. If we wait for another venue reviewers will see us as incremental, 6 months of work down the drain. Are the runs done? What are the BBH and TruthfulQA numbers?

@gdm-research-agent can you take the results table across the line? Fill in the remaining cells in main.tex and give us a one-paragraph summary of where we land vs the baselines. Ping if anything's blocking.
